UNITED STATES SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE COMMISSION
Washington, D.C. 20549

FORM 10-K — ANNUAL REPORT

For the fiscal year ended September 30, 2023

APPLE INC.
CIK: 0000320193
Ticker: AAPL

ITEM 1. BUSINESS

Apple Inc. designs, manufactures and markets smartphones, personal computers, tablets,
wearables and accessories, and sells a variety of related services. The Company's products
and services include iPhone, Mac, iPad, AirPods, Apple TV, Apple Watch, Beats products,
HomePod, iPod touch and accessories. The Company operates various platforms including the
App Store, Apple Music, Apple TV+, iCloud, Apple Pay, and AppleCare.

ITEM 1A. RISK FACTORS

A significant portion of the Company's net sales comes from a single customer.
The Company relies on access to third-party intellectual property, which may not be
available on reasonable terms or at all. Global and regional economic conditions could
materially adversely affect the Company.

ITEM 7. MANAGEMENT'S DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS

FISCAL YEAR 2023 HIGHLIGHTS:
- Total net sales: $383.3 billion (2022: $394.3 billion, -3% YoY)
- Net income: $97.0 billion (2022: $99.8 billion)
- Diluted EPS: $6.13 (2022: $6.11)
- Operating cash flow: $114.1 billion
- Free cash flow: $99.6 billion

SEGMENT PERFORMANCE:
- iPhone: $200.6B (-2% YoY)
- Services: $85.2B (+9% YoY — all-time record)
- Mac: $29.4B (-27% YoY)
- iPad: $28.3B (-3% YoY)
- Wearables, Home & Accessories: $39.8B (-3% YoY)
